summary: Regression + feature validation for the new Orders Alerts UX (sound/notification/tab-title badge/mark-seen). Backend regression: 49 passed, 1 skipped on existing pytest suite (test_upxero_backend.py + test_upxero_status_timing.py) — no changes, no regressions. Frontend: verified initial tab title, first-load seeding (no badge on mount), alerts toggle state change, new-order detection within polling (<10s), badge format '(1) Bestellingen · Upxero Ordering', dedup across additional 15s poll cycle (count stayed at 1), 'Markeer als gezien' resets badge and does NOT re-trigger over 12s, toggle off/on both as owner and staff, staff can access the screen and see tenant's orders. No AudioContext/Notification/document.title console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders.jsx is tidy (<370 LOC) and uses refs for dedup correctly. Note: initial seeding runs on first successful /orders response; if the very first poll fails (catch sets orders=[] but does not call detectNew), seededRef remains false — the next successful poll would seed from that moment, which is actually the desired behavior.
notifyNew() still playChime() even when alertsOn gated the call — fine, but ensure chime only triggers after enableAlerts() ran (currently guaranteed by alertsOn check in detectNew).
Unrelated: Background 401 responses seen in console on dashboard pages — pre-existing, not related to this feature.
seed_data_creation: Created a single public order via POST /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo/orders (customer QA, pickup, 1x Classic Cheeseburger) during the test; ~#1071 generated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend route for public API returns 403 to urllib default UA; from inside the browser (same page.evaluate fetch) it works fine. If you need to create orders from python, add a browser UA header. Alerts feature verified end-to-end at 2026-01 against preview env.
